Our Process

A Transparent Path From Brief to Building

Every Prodigy project follows a structured, client-visible process that protects quality, cost and programme.

PRODIGY CONSTRUCTION LIMITED

06 / Delivery process

Twelve clear stages. One accountable journey.

  1. 01

    Initial consultation

    We listen to your brief, objectives and constraints before recommending an approach.

  2. 02

    Requirements analysis

    We translate your requirements into a clear scope of works and delivery criteria.

  3. 03

    Site assessment

    Surveys, ground conditions and access constraints are assessed early.

  4. 04

    Feasibility

    We test technical, commercial and programme feasibility before commitment.

  5. 05

    Design & engineering

    Drawings, specifications and engineering input are developed with buildability in mind.

  6. 06

    Cost planning

    Transparent cost plans and budgets are agreed before construction starts.

  7. 07

    Procurement

    Materials, subcontractors and plant are procured against approved schedules.

  8. 08

    Construction

    Delivered through structured programmes, experienced crews and disciplined site management.

  9. 09

    Quality inspection

    Hold points, inspections and testing verify quality at every critical stage.

  10. 10

    Testing & commissioning

    Systems and services are tested and commissioned to handover standards.

  11. 11

    Handover

    Documentation, training and asset records are handed over in an organised way.

  12. 12

    Maintenance

    Post-handover support and maintenance keep the asset performing through its service life.
